|strategy=By [mailto:chlund@gate.net Charles Lund], Gold 43<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/light/small/youdohaveyourmoments.html</ref>

"During a battle, before any cards have been forfeited, cause all attition for both sides to be reduced to zero"

This card can be a life-saver for a "mains and toys" Light Side deck. These types of decks often have many low-destiny numbers, due to multiple copies of main characters such as [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]] and [[Son Of Skywalker]], as well as lots of lightsabers and locations. If the Light Side player hopes to protect their people from being devastated by overwhelming destiny draws and modifiers caused by the Dark Side, this card can keep your characters out long enough to get support from your own cards later in the game.

Using this card, the Light Side can freely initiate battles against any Dark Side character alone at a location, as you now have a way to get around the battle destiny adders the opponent uses to protect their characters. If you end up drawing a low number for attrition, and you opponent draws a high number, you can just play this card to have both sides not lose anything, instead of you losing a main and your opponent losing generic Imperial person!

Combos:

[[You Do Have Your Moments]] + character with attrition immunity = saving a good person from dying due to a fortuitous draw by the Dark Side.

You Do Have You Moments + initiating your own battle = opponent's destiny modifiers going to waste.
